tasks.label: Regenerate Rust Code
tasks.command: rm -rf lib/src/rust/* && rm -f rust/src/frb_generated.rs && flutter_rust_bridge_codegen generate

tasks.label: Run Rust Tests
tasks.command: for toml in $(find . -name Cargo.toml -not -path '*/target/*' -not -path '*/.*'); do cargo test --manifest-path "$toml" || exit 1; done
